description: Rijnbuurt-Oost (Plan Zuid, BAG 1934-35), Boterdiepstraat 4-70 and Eemsstraat: a 6.1 m brick front of a narrow window axis and a wide axis carrying a three-storey canted brick erker (white-framed three-light glazing over brick stallrisers on storeys 1-3), a pair of house doors under the narrow axis and a wide three-light window under the erker, mirrored in pairs so two erkers stand either side of one party wall, under the row's deep flat-roof overhang

overhang.note: the row's flat-roof overhang runs over the erker tops

door-left.note: house doors under the narrow axis at the outer party wall; the erker console is the slab over the ground window

match.note: the erker (2.75 m, brick-panelled) is the tell; the strip structure reads no light bay on it, so type and mirroring are decided by the photo (auto-place --photo-decides)

rhythm.bays: a narrow window axis and a wide erker axis
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored in pairs: the erkers stand either side of one party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: paired house doors at the outer party wall, a wide window under the erker
rhythm.roofline: flat roof with a deep white-fascia overhang over the erkers

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2022-03-24 (40 px/m), ruler crop of 32-34: erker 2.65-5.4 m on the 6.1 m front (2.75 m), its foot slab 3.0-3.2 m, glazing 4.15-6.05 / 7.2-9.4 / 10.8-12.6 m rectified (the erker front is ~0.6 m nearer the 6.4 m camera, so true 4.1-5.7 / 6.7-8.7 / 10.0-11.6 m); narrow axis window 0.05-1.45 m, 4.0-6.0 m; doors 0-1.75 m
